mapper.sql: SELECT r.INSTITUTION_ID, r.ROUND_SEQ, r.ANCHOR_LAST_BID, r.CLOSED_LAST_BID, r.CLOSE_REASON_CD, i.LAST_BID AS CUR_LAST_BID, l.REV_NO, l.STATUS_CD, l.HANDLED_AT FROM NOTICE_ROUND r JOIN NOTICE_ROUND_LOG l ON l.INSTITUTION_ID = r.INSTITUTION_ID AND l.ROUND_SEQ = r.ROUND_SEQ LEFT JOIN INSTITUTIONS i ON i.INSTITUTION_ID = r.INSTITUTION_ID WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM NOTICE_ROUND m WHERE m.INSTITUTION_ID = r.INSTITUTION_ID AND m.ROUND_SEQ > r.ROUND_SEQ) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM NOTICE_ROUND_LOG n WHERE n.INSTITUTION_ID = l.INSTITUTION_ID AND n.ROUND_SEQ = l.ROUND_SEQ AND n.REV_NO > l.REV_NO)
